verdict.rationale: Dynadot's security page says it offers two-factor authentication, account lock, and optional Registry Lock, which covers the 2FA part of account hardening. The API docs describe broad programmatic account control, but nothing in the pack shows that credentials can be scoped or that API access can be restricted to allowlisted IPs. Missing for 10: scoped/least-privilege API credentials, IP allowlisting on API access, detail on 2FA methods (TOTP/hardware keys), independent or hands-on corroboration.
